description: This file defines the interface for the IAVBufferHelper class, which provides methods for handling buffer mapping, unmapping, and data copy operations related to AV buffers. It includes function declarations for memory management, buffer size retrieval, and secure data writing, along with a factory function to instantiate the helper.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An abstract class defining helper functions for buffer handling, including mapping/unmapping memory, retrieving buffer size, and copying data between secure buffers.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a handle, returning a pointer to the mapped memory and setting the size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory mapped to a specific handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by a handle.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers using a specified mapping.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
